Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing port districts to lease land acquired from a commercial waterway district.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to land acquired from a commercial waterwaydistrict; and adding a new section to chapter 53.08 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 53.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A district may lease all lands, wharves, docks, and real andpersonal property it owns and controls that have been acquired fromcommercial waterway districts, for such purposes and upon such terms asthe port commission deems proper. These properties are subject to allother statutes governing district leases. (2) A port commission may, by resolution, authorize the managingofficial of a port district to sell and convey port district propertyobtained by the district from a commercial waterway district. Thedistrict shall sell and convey such property in accordance with allapplicable statutes governing the sale of district property.
